digest.component_or_area: store git operations and local locking
propositions: local git call sites contend on shared lock files (.git/index.lock, ref locks) under high concurrent local use; contention surfaces as errors to agents instead of being absorbed

transient git lock conflicts should resolve silently with bounded jittered retry/backoff; only permanently stuck locks (bounded budget exhausted) should surface one actionable error naming the lock file and holder guidance

per-store advisory lock plus jittered backoff on git call sites serialize rebar's writers while allowing silent recovery from transient lock conflicts, consistent with git's own lockfile.c retry pattern
uncontended git operations must add no latency (zero sleep on happy path); contention-related sleeps must be jittered by uniform[0.75, 1.25] to de-synchronize competing processes

every local git call site must be bounded with a watchdog timeout (120s for write operations, 300s for read-only walks) justified against local latency, not network timeouts, to distinguish wedged from slow
